about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Free, bilingual preparation for Bihar STET Paper II & BPSC TRE Computer Science.
about.missionText: Computer Science teacher exams deserve the same serious, structured preparation as any other competitive exam. We built this platform to give every Bihar STET & BPSC TRE aspirant free, high-quality, bilingual study material — no paywalls, no guesswork.
about.storyText: Scattered notes, paid test series and confusing notifications make CS teacher preparation harder than it needs to be. So we organised the entire official syllabus into 17 chapters with notes, quizzes and mock tests that mirror the real exam pattern — in both English and हिंदी.
about.f1d: Notes, questions and explanations in English and हिंदी — switch anytime.
about.f2d: Questions and CBT mock tests modelled on actual STET & BPSC TRE shifts.
about.f3d: Streaks, scores and chapter-wise progress to keep you consistent.
about.f4d: Built for aspirants — no subscription, no hidden charges, ever.
about.ctaText: Explore the syllabus or jump straight into practice questions.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters. This page explains what data Bihar STET & BPSC CS collects, why, and how you can control it.
privacy.s1b: When you sign in with Google we receive your name, email address and profile picture. We also store what you do on the platform: quiz and mock test scores, progress and your ranking. If you send us a message via the contact form, we keep the name and email you provide.
privacy.s2b: To save your progress across devices, show you on the leaderboard, keep your daily streak and reply to your questions. We never sell your data.
privacy.s3b: Your data is stored on our hosting provider's secure database (MongoDB on Render). Local preferences such as theme and language are kept in your browser's localStorage.
privacy.s4b: We use Google Analytics (GA4) to understand aggregate usage, and Google OAuth for sign-in. Analytics cookies are measurement-only; we do not track you across unrelated sites.
privacy.s5b: Google (sign-in and analytics) and Brevo (for form emails, only if you contact us). Each has its own privacy policy governing how they handle data.
privacy.s6b: You can close your account and ask us to delete your data at any time by contacting us. Progress is tied to your Google account — sign out of Google on shared devices so no one else can view it.
privacy.s7b: This platform is intended for candidates and educators preparing for competitive exams. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13.
privacy.s8b: We may update this policy. If we do, the 'last updated' date above changes. Continued use of the site after changes means you accept the updated policy.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: By using Bihar STET & BPSC CS you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.
terms.s1b: Accessing or using the platform means you accept these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the site.
terms.s2b: Our notes, questions and mock tests are study aids. They are not official BSEB or BPSC material. Always verify eligibility, dates and syllabus with the official BSEB and BPSC notifications.
terms.s3b: You are responsible for your account activity. Don't share credentials in a way that risks another user's data, and don't use the platform to spam, harass or cheat.
terms.s4b: The study material is our original work and is protected by copyright. You may use it for personal, non-commercial study. Redistribution of the material in courses, books or for resale is not allowed.
terms.s5b: We work hard to keep content accurate, but exams and notifications change. We make no guarantee that any question, prediction or score is error-free.
terms.s6b: We may link to official or external sites. We are not responsible for their content or privacy practices.
terms.s7b: To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any indirect or consequential loss arising from your use of the platform.
terms.s8b: We may update these terms. Questions? Contact us through the contact page.
